_about: 1-Butanol (1) + Isooctane (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 1-butanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 1-butanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Rubio-Perez, Gabriel, Munoz-Rujas, Natalia, Srhiyer, Adil, Montero, Eduardo A., Aguilar, Fernando, Isobaric vapor-liquid equilibrium, density and speed of sound of binary mixtures 2,2,4-trimethylpentane + 1-butanol or dibutyl ether (DBE) at 101.3 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilib. 475 (2018) 10-17
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 16, 17. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0083. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.49 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
